microsoftLearnSources.title: Register a new vendor - Business Central
microsoftLearnSources.use: Vendor setup uses template selection and then the vendor card; after the card is completed it can be used on purchase documents.

microsoftLearnSources.title: Posting group setup - Business Central
microsoftLearnSources.use: Posting groups map vendors, items, resources and documents to G/L accounts and reduce posting mistakes.

microsoftLearnSources.title: Acquire fixed assets - Business Central
microsoftLearnSources.use: Fixed-asset acquisition can be posted through a vendor, but only after the fixed asset and depreciation book setup are ready.

decision.reason: FIXEDASSETS-036 proves that K30000 is not visible in the filtered Vendors page. A purchase invoice or fixed-asset acquisition would therefore skip a mandatory master-data layer. The next safe step is exactly one UI-first vendor setup fit or a documented stop if template/card prerequisites are not visible.

approvedNextRunScope.goal: Create or confirm exactly vendor K30000 as CRONUS-USA lab vendor master data, then read the visible card defaults.
allowedActions: filter No.=K30000 and confirm whether it is still missing
if missing, start New only from the Vendors list context
select a vendor template only if the dialog is visible and can be cancelled or confirmed safely
set or confirm No.=K30000 and Name=Zollspedition Nord GmbH
fill only visible non-posting descriptive fields when required by the UI
save only the vendor card, then reopen/read it
document visible Vendor Posting Group, Gen. Bus. Posting Group, Payment Terms Code, Currency Code, Tax/VAT context and Blocked status as actual lab defaults
capture before, template/card, after and final-card screenshots
stopCriteria: BC opens a different environment than MCP_1_20260210
New opens an unrelated page or ambiguous Role Center action
template dialog cannot be scoped to vendor creation
No. cannot be set to K30000 or another record already owns K30000
required posting, payment, currency or tax fields are blank but not visibly/default safely supplied
a purchase invoice, acquisition, depreciation or posting dialog appears unexpectedly
forbiddenActions: claim German 19-percent VAT, German chart-of-accounts or German HGB final proof
use API shortcuts for vendor creation

bookImpact: Chapter 21 now needs a visible K30000 setup checkpoint between the fitted FA-CNC-01 card and any purchase invoice/acquisition step. The book should explain that a missing vendor is not a minor lookup inconvenience but a payables, posting-group, payment-term and tax-context gate.
beginnerLearning: A filtered empty Vendors list means the target vendor is not available for a purchase invoice. The correct reaction is not to force the invoice but to create or confirm the vendor card first and then inspect the defaults Business Central will use for payables and posting.
